assumptions.description: The task defines an equal-cell analytical design: exactly 375 rows for each sex crossed with four age bands. Integer ages are independently discrete-uniform within each assigned band; this is not Mexico population age weighting.

Transfer the selected Lifelines BMI/glucose marginal means and SDs and HbA1c baseline to the eligible Mexican design as an explicit weak population-transport assumption. No target numerical calibration is available. Plasma-to-serum, ancestry, assay, fast duration, anemia and medication differences are unresolved.

U is standardized Beta(2,5), and V,W are independent standardized Beta(3,3). These variables are also independent of age and female. BMI-glucose correlation is assumed 0.25. Distribution shapes and all implied support boundaries are model restrictions, not reported physiological cutoffs.

Age/female have no effects on BMI/glucose in this minimal completion, and the direct female coefficient in HbA1c is zero. These are unsupported completion assumptions, not empirical absence-of-association findings. HbA1c has an additive conditional mean and independent bounded residual.

Assume the Table1 selected-cohort margins are applicable to both separate Table2 projection populations, although row-specific sample sizes and missingness are unresolved. The two published slopes are imposed as separate projections, never as joint coefficients.

Transfer the Pani NHANES age projection 0.01 percentage points/year into the age coefficient of the common linear conditional law; this requires constant slope, correct linear conditioning, and population/measurement transport. It is not a causal aging effect or a verified Mexican coefficient.

For qualified analytic checks only, Lifelines age is continuous uniform with mean55.5/SD9.9 and female Bernoulli0.597; Pani age is 25+Gamma(shape4,scale7.5) and female Bernoulli0.5. Both source contexts use the same U,V,W and conditional outcome law as the generator. Source age/sex laws are approximations, distinct from target quotas, not reconstructed data or survey weights. Pani age has no upper cutoff.

Source laws describe people already selected under each paper's supplied criteria, including positive glucose below126. They do not simulate preselection populations. Target rows are conditional on all task eligibility restrictions; questionnaire and anthropometry validity cannot be verified from the five generated fields. Do not assert verified medication/anemia exclusions for the target.

Use Jansen's directly reported rounded percent SD0.3 as one individual-dispersion anchor. Alternative IFCC-derived percent SD0.27444 is retained evidence, not a second independent constraint. Independent residual variance is derived by subtracting explained variance in the declared Lifelines law.

Scientific parameters are fixed nominal evidence/assumption settings. Pani ageband SEs measure uncertainty of means, never individual SD. Jansen CI levels and Pani slope SE are not supplied; no probability distribution over parameters or inverse-variance pooling is invented. Seeds quantify conditional row variability only.

Pani survey ageband means remain contextual. Their marginal age trend and levels cannot establish the conditional age coefficient or target intercept without the missing within-band weighted covariate distributions. The common Lifelines baseline is not claimed to reproduce Pani means; the >=70 band is not silently limited at79.

design.derivation: Task-mandated quotas and allowed age/sex coding; within-band uniformity is author completion.

margins.derivation: Use reported percent HbA1c row; glucose mmol/L multiplied by protocol factor18.0. No pooling of duplicate unit representations.

source_constraints.derivation: Separate Jansen slopes after scale-only conversion; Pani adjusted age slope nominal point value.

latent.derivation: Explicit, unidentified shape and correlation completion. No source covariance is claimed.

coefficients.derivation: Solve kB=b+g*rho*sG/sB and kG=g+b*rho*sB/sG. Set a=Pani age projection. residual_sd squared =0.3^2-a^2*9.9^2-b^2*sB^2-g^2*sG^2-2*b*g*rho*sB*sG. See mathematical_properties.md and analytic_check.py.

source_contexts.derivation: Lifelines first two age moments and sex probability anchored to source. Functional distribution and all Pani covariate details assumed; Pani gamma has positive support above25 without target79 cap.
